name: Formula 1
author: Davy Willems
description: A Game & Watch-style LCD racer: move your car left and right to avoid the oncoming traffic and set a high score. Left/right to steer, X to start.

descriptions.en: A Game & Watch-style LCD racer: move your car left and right to avoid the oncoming traffic and set a high score. Left/right to steer, X to start.
descriptions.it: Un gioco LCD in stile Game & Watch: sposta la tua auto a destra e a sinistra per evitare il traffico e fai il record. Sinistra/destra per sterzare, X per iniziare.
